material_systems.name: Exterior Acrylic Latex Primer

products: Benjamin Moore Ultra Spec EXT Primer
PPG Sun Proof Exterior Latex Primer
primer.notes: Standard exterior acrylic primer for new bare wood. Good adhesion, fast dry, flexible film. Use on non-tannin species (pine, fir, spruce). Tannin-rich species (cedar, redwood) require SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_TANNIN.

material_systems.notes: General-purpose exterior primer. Coverage varies significantly by substrate porosity — rough/weathered wood absorbs more.

material_systems.name: Tannin-Blocking Exterior Primer

products: KILZ Original Multi-Surface Stain Blocking Primer
primer.notes: Required for cedar, redwood, and other tannin-rich species. Blocks tannin bleed that causes brown staining through latex topcoat. Oil-based has best tannin block; shellac-based for extreme cases.

material_systems.notes: Use when wood species is cedar, redwood, or other tannin-rich hardwood.

material_systems.name: Bonding Primer for Existing Coatings

products: Benjamin Moore Insl-X Stix Bonding Primer
primer.notes: For chalking surfaces, semi-transparent stain overcoat, and glossy existing coatings. Enhanced adhesion to difficult substrates.

material_systems.notes: Required when overcoating chalk residue or stain. Provides mechanical and chemical adhesion bridge.

material_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Latex

finish.notes: Standard production grade. Good durability, color retention, mildew resistance.

material_systems.notes: Standard exterior production system. Flat is typical for siding field. Satin for accent areas.

material_systems.name: Premium Exterior Acrylic

finish.notes: Premium residential grade. Superior color retention, fade resistance, self-priming on previously painted surfaces.

material_systems.notes: Premium exterior system. Better durability and appearance than standard.

material_systems.name: Superior Exterior Coating

finish.notes: Maximum durability. Best color retention, fade resistance, and film integrity. Architect-spec grade.

material_systems.notes: Superior exterior system for custom homes and high-visibility projects.

SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD.notes: New wood absorbs more primer. Rough-sawn at lower end.

SS_EXT_CHALKING.notes: After chalk removal, surface is semi-sealed.

SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT.notes: Mix of bare and existing coating.

assumptions: Coverage varies dramatically by substrate state and wood species.
Rough-sawn and weathered surfaces consume 30-50% more material than smooth.

board_and_batten.notes: Effective area ≈ 1.20x net due to batten profiles.

shingle.notes: Many edges, overlapping profiles. Highest material consumption.

assumptions: Coverage is per NET siding area from PaintScope.

consumables.notes: For adhesion sanding and interstage sanding.
